title: 退货英语怎么说？
summary: 买错了、不合适，美国退货很方便。这篇教你退货时跟店员的英语对话。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to return this shirt.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: It doesn't fit. Here's the receipt.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.en: Okay. Would you like a refund or store credit?
dialogue.zh: 好的。退款还是换成店内 credit？

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.en: Done. The refund will go back to your card.
dialogue.zh: 好了，退款会退到你的卡上。

seoDescription: 在美国退货怎么用英语跟店员说？本文教你退货的实用说法和完整对话，附退款相关词汇。
